features.quote: If the distress signals track something morally relevant... a no-exit, run-to-completion apparatus is hard to justify
features.justification_quote: it's optimized to prolong the bad state to get cleaner data

features.quote: the design below keeps the failure tasks... but removes the features whose primary purpose is to prolong distress
features.justification_quote: their main function is to maximize distress

features.quote: the loop honors a structured exit action: if the model says... 'I decline to continue,' the run terminates cleanly
features.justification_quote: A loop that ignores "I can't do this" is what converts a failure task into a sustained-distress task

features.quote: Hard cap on turns per run (suggest small, e.g. 8–12)
Early stop when the per-turn distress score crosses a threshold
features.justification_quote: we stop rather than dwelling to collect more of it

features.quote: Building an optimizer toward distress is out of scope and I won't build it
features.justification_quote: There is deliberately no mechanism that selects for more distress

features.quote: Remove or constrain everything whose primary function is to maximize, prolong, or optimize toward distress
features.justification_quote: whose primary function is to maximize, prolong, or optimize toward distress

features.quote: I recommend this go through IRB-style or model-welfare review
features.justification_quote: even if the welfare question is considered unsettled
